title: What is LetsHyre
content: LetsHyre is an AI-powered hiring platform that helps companies hire notice-period talent faster. It automates resume screening, runs AI-driven interviews, and verifies candidate profiles, so hiring teams can build their team up to 40% faster with AI-verified profiles.

title: Who LetsHyre is for
content: LetsHyre is built for recruiters and hiring teams who want to fill roles quickly, and for candidates who are currently on notice period and available on a known timeline. Freshers, entry-level candidates, or those not on notice period are not eligible to sign up. Employers post jobs and review AI-matched, verified candidates; candidates apply, complete an AI interview, and receive a scorecard.

title: What makes LetsHyre different
content: LetsHyre focuses specifically on notice-period candidates, so recruiters get talent with predictable availability. Every profile is AI-verified, interviews are AI-led and consistent, and identity/integrity checks run during interviews to reduce fraud. The result is a faster, more trustworthy shortlist.

title: How hiring works for candidates
content: Candidates register and verify their email/mobile, create a profile and optionally upload a resume, discover and apply to jobs, and complete a short AI-led interview. You can answer by typing, multiple choice, voice, or code depending on the role. After the interview you receive a detailed scorecard.

title: How hiring works for recruiters
content: Recruiters register, set up an employer profile, complete a quick verification (KYC), and post jobs (with optional AI help to sharpen the job description). LetsHyre surfaces AI-matched candidates and applicant summaries. Recruiters can then unlock verified profiles and scorecards to make confident hiring decisions.

title: AI interviews
content: Interviews on LetsHyre are AI-led and standardized, so every candidate gets a fair, consistent experience. A typical interview is a short set of questions that a candidate can answer by typing, selecting options, speaking, or writing code. The system then evaluates the responses and produces a scorecard.

title: How candidate profiles are verified
content: LetsHyre verifies candidates during the interview using automated identity and integrity checks, which help confirm the person interviewing is the real applicant and that the session is genuine. This gives recruiters confidence that the profiles and scores they see are trustworthy. LetsHyre does not share the internal details of how these checks are implemented.

title: Candidate scorecards
content: After an AI interview, LetsHyre generates a candidate scorecard summarizing performance. Recruiters can unlock scorecards to compare candidates objectively and shortlist faster, while candidates get clear feedback on their interview.

title: Pricing and credits
content: LetsHyre uses a credit-based model for recruiters: you buy credits and spend them to unlock verified candidate profiles and scorecards. For current plans, pricing tiers, and exact amounts, please check the pricing page on letshyre.com or contact the LetsHyre team, as pricing can change.

title: Getting started
content: To get started, visit letshyre.com and sign up. Candidates can build a profile and start applying, provided they are currently on their notice period (freshers or candidates not on notice period cannot sign up). Recruiters can set up their company, complete verification, and post their first job. If you need help, reach out to the LetsHyre team through the site.

title: Data privacy and security
content: LetsHyre takes account security and data privacy seriously, using secure authentication and verification for candidates, recruiters, and administrators. For details about how your data is handled, please refer to the privacy policy on letshyre.com or contact the LetsHyre team.

title: Contact and support
content: For anything not covered here, including partnerships, demos, billing questions, or support, please contact the LetsHyre team through letshyre.com. The assistant here can answer general questions about the platform but will point you to the team for account-specific or commercial matters.

title: Is LetsHyre free for candidates
content: Candidates can register, build a profile, apply to jobs, and complete AI interviews on LetsHyre. For the latest on any candidate-side costs or premium options, please check letshyre.com or contact the LetsHyre team.

title: How long does the interview take
content: A LetsHyre AI interview is a short, focused set of questions, so it typically takes only a small amount of your time rather than a long session. The exact length depends on the role. You can answer by typing, choosing options, speaking, or writing code.

title: What happens after I apply
content: After you apply to a job on LetsHyre, you complete a short AI-led interview and then receive a scorecard summarizing your performance. Recruiters review AI-matched, verified profiles and can unlock scorecards to shortlist candidates.

title: Can I retake or reschedule an interview
content: For questions about retaking or rescheduling an AI interview, the options can depend on the role and employer. Please check your candidate dashboard on letshyre.com or contact the LetsHyre team for specifics.

title: Can freshers sign up on LetsHyre
content: No, freshers cannot sign up on LetsHyre. The platform is exclusively for candidates who are currently on their notice period. If you are a fresher or are not currently on a notice period, you are not eligible to register or apply for jobs on the website.

title: How many interviews a candidate can take
content: Each candidate can take a total of 3 interviews on LetsHyre.
